Any major code-generation or board-integration template redesign rather than bounded materialization or a localized causal repair.
Any unresolved ambiguity in sample-project targets, Vivado export contexts, compile executables, module names, or paths after bounded evidence-based discovery; no target may be guessed.

observations: The only directly executed current-layer real-tool failure is case_multilayer_pipeline. It reports missing complete all-target-layer Transformer-block DUT binding and missing hash-verified multilayer harness sources.

board_tb.sv is missing as a functional-simulation precondition. It must be materialized from the frozen verification contract and exact sample-project source identity, not replaced by a simplified testbench or wrapper.

case_axi_ddr_interface and all VCS, deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, multilayer functional, numeric, and board-semantic evidence are currently not_run behind failed prerequisites. Their residual reports are planning evidence, not current pass or failure evidence.

The visible AXI/DDR interface report also identifies unresolved current-layer source-identity, Vivado compile-authority, authority-reference, and executable-authorization bindings. These must be reconciled from actual discovery and Vivado export facts without guessing names or paths.

The supplied VCS functional diagnosis is explicitly historical_only because it is not bound to the current failed gate and live source artifacts. The prior zero-time-livelock specialist feedback remains a useful conditional failure lesson but is not the first executable action.

The current debug closure has no failing transaction, failed boundary, violated contract, or lower-layer challenge. Its targeted replay status is needs_boundary_trace, so no RTL root candidate is presently authorized.

The operator-leaf and connected single-layer certificates are live and hash validated. The connected kernel is certified as an elastic rate-insensitive token pipeline with preserved boundary order and required cross-token overlap; unequal stage durations are not a defect by themselves.

No current trace contradicts a lower-layer ready/valid, convergence, order, or semantic invariant. Reopening RMSNorm, AttentionGQA, LlamaStyleBlock, or other certified kernel sources is therefore prohibited at this point.

sacg_memory_truth identifies 10 active same-scope contamination barriers and 4 open retry requests, with no open same-scope backtrack request. Rejected Stage7 and Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only until a new content-addressed board candidate passes and is promoted.
The conditional design-team router selected no specialist split. This does not change the tool-evidence decision or transfer responsibility for current-layer closure.

Functional acceptance must use the same immutable checkpoint and stimulus for DUT and independent target-model Transformer-block inference, retain the frozen numeric policy and tolerances, and prove executed consumption of every required bound Transformer-block tensor in every target layer.
proposed_actions: Repair the current board-layer verification capability by materializing the frozen exact-board multilayer harness and complete all-target-layer Transformer-block tensor binding, then rerun case_multilayer_pipeline.
Reconcile the exact sample-project source identity, Vivado compile authority, authorized commands, and board simulation contract, then run case_axi_ddr_interface.
After both prerequisites pass, run a fresh exact-board VCS execution with boundary monitors and targeted replay enabled, using immutable semantic inputs and source hashes.

Only if the fresh current run proves a zero-time livelock that the existing analyzer cannot localize, implement and run a VCS-native process/toggle-cone localizer; do not reuse the historical timestamp as current evidence.

Apply a bounded repair only to the checker, instrumentation, loader, generated board integration, scheduler, or current-layer causal slice named by the fresh localization. Preserve the exact wrapper and all immutable semantic artifacts.
Rerun the complete board-layer gate DAG with a cold exact-board simulation and require functional, liveness, order, AXI, DDR, numeric, semantic, and complete weight-consumption evidence.

After every board-layer checker passes on one content-addressed candidate, reconcile the 10 active barriers and 4 open retry requests; otherwise leave them active and return to the current-layer trace loop.
risks: Running the proposed native VCS toggle-cone diagnosis before repairing case_multilayer_pipeline and exact-board identity would reuse historical evidence outside its binding and could lead to speculative ready/valid or cadence edits.
A manifest that merely lists weight files can falsely suggest coverage. Complete tensor hashes, loader and harness bindings, and executed per-tensor DUT consumption evidence are all required.
Generating expected outputs from random data, an identity implementation, or DUT output would invalidate functional verification. Random generation is permitted only for deterministic input stimulus.
Model, shape, and layer-index mismatches can occur if the all-layer binding is assembled from sampled or single-layer artifacts instead of the complete target-checkpoint Transformer-block catalog.

Data-order, transfer-count, address-map, or lifecycle errors may remain after static binding closure. Independent AXI or prefetch progress cannot substitute for current output or lifecycle-frontier progress.

The pending compile plan is not yet bound to the current exact source identity and Vivado export authority. Guessing executables, top modules, libraries, or paths could silently substitute a non-board-accurate target.
Changing ready/valid cadence to force strict same-cycle behavior would violate certified elastic pipeline semantics and could regress valid cross-token overlap.
Producing board semantic evidence before functional, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, deadlock, numeric, and weight-consumption checks pass would bypass the gate DAG.
Any use of contaminated Stage7 or Stage8 artifacts as validated design inputs could incorrectly clear open retries or promote an unverified board candidate.
A current frontier stall, if later observed, will localize the next probes but will not by itself prove a DUT root cause or justify reopening the connected kernel.

constraints: Do not consume artifacts behind active contamination barriers as validated inputs.
Do not reopen certified lower layers without a current hash-bound named contradiction.
Preserve elastic variable-latency token-pipeline order and required cross-token overlap; strict same-cycle stage start or completion is not required.
Keep checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, expected outputs, numeric policy, tolerances, semantic testbench contract, and exact board-wrapper source hashes immutable.
Use the exact sample-project wrapper and simulation sources; do not substitute a simplified AXI/DDR wrapper or guess Vivado targets or executables.
Accelerator scope is Transformer blocks only; exclude embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, and sampling from DUT weight coverage and golden outputs.
